textbookBox.concept: Direct method: mean = sum of f x divided by sum of f, where x is the class mark.

beats.en: Direct method: mean = sum of f x divided by sum of f, where x is the class mark.
beats.speakEn: Direct method: mean  equals  sum of f x divided by sum of f, where x is the class mark.

beats.en: Assumed mean method: pick a convenient a and let d = x - a. Then mean = a + Σfd / Σf.
beats.speakEn: Assumed mean method: pick a convenient a and let d  equals  x - a. Then mean  equals  a + Σfd / Σf.
